g.text: Minimal power distribution board, 20 x 10 mm, two M2 holes.

g.desc: Minimal power distribution board, 20 x 10 mm, two M2 holes.

g.text: - J1 BATTERY: wire pads, 1 = BAT+, 2 = GND.

g.desc: - J1 BATTERY: wire pads, 1 = BAT+, 2 = GND.

g.text: - J2 SWITCH: an off-board SPST switch in series with battery +. 1 = BAT+, 2 = VOUT. Rate it for the full load current.

g.desc: - J2 SWITCH: an off-board SPST switch in series with battery +. 1 = BAT+, 2 = VOUT. Rate it for the full load current.

g.text: - J3 LOAD: wire pads, 1 = VOUT (switched battery +), 2 = GND.

g.desc: - J3 LOAD: wire pads, 1 = VOUT (switched battery +), 2 = GND.

g.text: - Pads 2.9 x 3.6 mm suit wires up to ~16 AWG. Copper path sized for ~5 A on 1 oz copper (see CLAUDE.md).
